group.blocked_cool: Heating is not possible: {{name}} is cooling or drying on the same outdoor unit (group {{group}}).

group.yield_fan_cool: {{device}} was set to fan only: master {{master}} started cooling or drying (group {{group}}) and cooling or drying cannot run together with heating on one outdoor unit.
